steps.meaning: Hollis Vantour LLC files building permit application BP-2214 with the Larkspur County Building Department.
steps.name: application_filed

steps.meaning: The department accepts BP-2214 as complete at 9:15 AM on Monday 10 August 2026.
steps.name: application_accepted_complete

steps.meaning: The fifteen-business-day count begins on the first business day after acceptance, which is Tuesday 11 August 2026.
steps.name: count_start

steps.meaning: The department issues a written request for additional information on BP-2214 at 3:00 PM on Thursday 13 August 2026.
steps.name: request_for_info_issued

steps.meaning: From the moment the request is issued until the department receives a complete response, the request is outstanding, affecting business day counting.
steps.name: request_outstanding_period

steps.meaning: Hollis Vantour LLC delivers a complete response to the request, logged at 10:00 AM on Wednesday 26 August 2026.
steps.name: response_delivered

steps.meaning: The request for additional information is no longer outstanding after the complete response is received.
steps.name: request_resolved

steps.meaning: The business day count resumes on the next business day after the request is resolved, which is Thursday 27 August 2026.
steps.name: count_resumes

steps.meaning: The fifteenth counted business day arrives at 5:00 PM, triggering deemed approval if no written decision has been issued.
steps.name: fifteenth_business_day_arrives

steps.meaning: The Building Department issues a written approval of BP-2214 before the deadline.
steps.name: written_approval_issued
steps.uncertainty: The department has stated no reviewer will be assigned before 21 September 2026, making written approval before the deadline impossible.

steps.meaning: A plan reviewer completes review of BP-2214, a prerequisite for written approval or denial.
steps.name: plan_review_completed
steps.uncertainty: No reviewer will be assigned before 21 September 2026, so this cannot occur before the deadline.

steps.meaning: A plan reviewer is assigned to BP-2214.
steps.name: reviewer_assigned
steps.uncertainty: Director confirmed no reviewer will be assigned before 21 September 2026.
